tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All hematological parameters are within normal limits except for a mildly elevated erythrocyte count and a markedly increased platelet distribution width, which may indicate increased platelet size variability. No acute pathology is evident, but the findings may warrant correlation with clinical context and possible follow-up if there are relevant symptoms or risk factors.
